turn_text: Glad to be with you.

This week we're going to have the markup of the Farm Bill in the House of Representatives and you went through this last year and produced a bill that never made it to the House floor for debate. Are you of the opinion this year's bill will get floor time?

Well, at this point it looks like it. I was fairly upset with the process last year and sent a letter to the leadership, letting them know that. I've sent Sam the number of meetings with Mr. Boehner, speaker, and he indicates to me that he wants to get this done, he wants to get it reauthorized before it expires in September, and I take him at his word. Since then, Chairman Locus has met with Cantor, the majority leader, who I think was the reason that it was blocked last time. And, you know, they had some discussions about the end of the day in the stuff that they put together in terms of what they're bringing up on the floor. They've got the Farm Bill as one of the items that they will be considering this summer. So, at this point, it appears, you know, that we get this bill out of committee next week, that we can move it to the floor, and really, there's not much else going on right now. turn_text: Provisions of the bill seem to be the big deal right now, and Derry is one of them. Have you addressed Speaker Boehner's concerns in that area?
